# Nextal Academy

> Nextal Academy is a job-oriented training institute in Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu, India, offering hands-on courses in video editing, motion graphics, generative AI, graphic design, UI/UX design, web development, app development and AI-integrated digital marketing, with placement support.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://nextalacademy.com/): Overview of the academy, courses and enrolment
- [Blog](https://nextalacademy.com/blogs): Articles on AI, digital marketing and tech careers
- [Placement](https://nextalacademy.com/placement): Placement support and student outcomes
